## Scientific change summary

Describe the scientific/engineering semantics changed.

## Affected contracts

- [ ] Endpoint / label derivation
- [ ] Temporal admission / watermark
- [ ] Identity / mapping / genomic harmonization
- [ ] Candidate universe / sampling frame
- [ ] Evidence taxonomy / independence
- [ ] Training / validation / lockbox
- [ ] Provider / license / source lineage
- [ ] Metrics / estimand / statistics
- [ ] Editorial only

## Required checks

- [ ] No unresolved P0 gate is silently bypassed.
- [ ] New knowledge-bearing dependency has provenance/watermark semantics.
- [ ] Golden/prohibited fixtures updated when semantics changed.
- [ ] QoI/MAP/MAR schema updated when governed fields changed.
- [ ] ADR added or amended for semantic changes.
- [ ] No future outcome information enters ranking.
- [ ] No current/latest provider is used implicitly.

## Review

Changes affecting endpoint, estimand, labels, identity, temporal admission, or lockbox policy require approval from a reviewer independent of the author before FROZEN V1.
